raised.claim: `guardHits` is only logged when `covered < orphans.length`, which checks raw LLM output before `planTriageActions` runs, so guard rejections on a full verdict batch are never logged.
raised.why_it_breaks: In normal operation the LLM emits one verdict per orphan in the batch (`covered === orphans.length`). If the guards reject or degrade those verdicts in `planTriageActions`, `covered < orphans.length` is still false and the `verdict shortfall` warning with `guardHits` is never emitted.

raised.claim: The saturation guard does not count verdicts attached earlier in the same batch, and the scope-violation guard is not applied to verdicts targeting `new_issues`.
raised.why_it_breaks: If an open issue starts a run with `postCreationRows = 11` (under `MAX_ROWS_PER_ISSUE = 12`) and the batch contains 20 verdicts for that issue, all 20 are accepted because `target.postCreationRows` is never incremented when `pushInto(byIssue, ...)` succeeds. Similarly, in the `else` branch for `new_issue_key`, `rowSatisfiesScope` is never checked against the proposed issue's `scope`.

raised.quote:
const body = `${issue.body}\n\n${renderScopeBlock(issue.scope)}`;
        const number = await github.createIssue({ title: issue.title, body, labels: issue.labels });
raised.claim: Because `openIssues` bodies in the prompt now contain ```` ```triage-scope ```` blocks, an LLM that echoes a ```` ```triage-scope ```` block inside `issue.body` will shadow the rendered block appended at the end.
raised.why_it_breaks: `parseScopeBlock` uses `BLOCK_RE.exec(body)`, which matches the first ```` ```triage-scope ```` fence in the issue body. Since `renderScopeBlock(issue.scope)` is appended after `issue.body`, any ```` ```triage-scope ```` block written by the model inside `issue.body` will be parsed on subsequent runs instead of the authoritative block at the end.

raised.claim: Degrading an unprobed `not_on_untappd` verdict to `matcher_bug` and pushing it to `quiet` causes `orphanTriage` to count it as `wontfix` in the daily digest outcome.
raised.why_it_breaks: In `src/jobs/orphan-triage.ts` (lines 346-350), the loop over `plan.quiet` does `if (v.review_class === 'not_on_untappd') outcome.notOnUntappd++; else outcome.wontfix++;`. Every `not_on_untappd` verdict degraded by Guard 3 to `matcher_bug` increments `outcome.wontfix` in the reported digest summary.

raised.claim: `setEnrichFailureReview` sets `issue_number`, but `recordEnrichFailure` does not clear `issue_number` when `candidates_count` crosses the `0 <-> >0` boundary and resets the review fields.
raised.why_it_breaks: When an already-triaged failure crosses between `candidates_count = 0` and `candidates_count > 0`, `recordEnrichFailure` resets `review_class`, `review_note`, and `reviewed_at` to `NULL` to re-open the row for triage, leaving the stale `issue_number` populated on an untriaged row.
